_about: The single source of truth for how an episode is made. studio.py next prints the card for the episode's stage; skills hold the technique, this file holds the order and the creator's rules. Change a rule HERE (one line), not in five skills.
always: Write instructions, questions and reports in English. Only the script, VO text and on-screen Bangla are Bangla.
Reports are brief: use the gate templates below. Never list checks that passed, never repeat what the creator already approved.
Do not start a stage the creator did not ask for, and do not redo a step that state.py shows done.
ONE voiceover per request (one take of vo_paste.txt). Never offer A/B takes.
No scene numbers, chapter labels or chips on screen. Scene names are internal.
Key graphics inside the centre 4:5 zone (y 285-1635) but never leave the top and bottom bands empty: bleed fills them.
Series typeface Tiro Bangla (preset vox-money) on every video. Never switch fonts per episode.

Look: Vox / Johnny Harris style. Use ONLY the colours of the palette assigned by studio.py look (docs/look.md). No palette picked by hand, no dull or dated colours. Top/bottom bands and style elements differ from earlier episodes.

Sound: music preset and automatic sound effects are assigned by studio.py and played by audio.py. Never replace the music by hand, never silence the effects, never add loud ones. data-mood on every scene (first = intro, last = end).
Ending holds ~3 s after the last VO line; the closing chord rings, the last line is never faded under.

Each video gets its own designed cover (palette of the episode), baked in as the first frame and embedded thumbnail. Covers are designed by hand per topic like episodes 1-5 (docs/cover-design.md): real photo or cutout hero, calm palette, big title >=140 px that asks without giving the answer, no top/bottom bars; each must print COVER PASS from cover_check.py.
In-video text must be readable: >=40 px running text, on screen early enough (audit FAILs text that has too little reading time). Earlier is fine, late is not.
out/ holds finals only: reel_9x16, feed_4x5, 2 cover PNGs, captions.bn_IN.srt, captions.en_US.srt, publish.txt.
Every number comes from facts.json (url + quote). Single-source numbers are said in the pinned comment.
One chat per episode per stage. Claim the episode before touching it; close with studio.py close.

reports.script: SCRIPT PASS - <n> scenes - est. <s> s (budget 60). Then the script table. Flags: max 3 one-line items. Ask only: OK?
reports.vo_and_images: One message: (1) the VO paste text in a code block, (2) the image table: # - filename - what it shows - REAL or AI (+ Gemini prompt for AI rows). No other text.
reports.ready: videoNN ready. Drop images in images/ and the single VO take in vo/raw/vo_full.mp3, then open a new chat: Build episode NN.
reports.missing: Cannot build yet: missing <what>. (one line, then stop)
reports.preview: Preview ready: <file> - <s> s - look <palette> - music <music>. Reply 'go ahead' or timestamped notes. (+1 line only if a cut/tempo/fix was a judgement call; +1 line 'time cut: ...' only if there is one)
reports.cover: Two covers: A <one line>, B <one line>. Pick A or B.
reports.delivered: Delivered ep NN - <s> s - cover <X> - videoNN/out/. Caveat: <single-source items, 1 line>. Next: <one step>.

plan: PLAN videoNN  (input = the title; no brief gate)
1. Research in standard search mode (several queries in one turn). Reuse the shared figures; facts.json rows need url + quote.
2. Write script.json + docs/script.md. One question, <=130 Bangla words (~60 s), ends with the 'কমেন্টে লিখুন' question.
3. python3 engine/tools/script_check.py videoNN  ->  must print SCRIPT PASS (fix every FAIL first).
4. Send the script (report 'script'). GATE: creator OK -> state.py videoNN approve script  (brief is auto-approved: state.py videoNN approve brief --note 'title given').
5. After OK, send ONE message (report 'vo_and_images'): vo_text.py videoNN -> vo/vo_paste.txt + the image table (video-script 3b).

6. Prepare folders: python3 engine/tools/studio.py new videoNN --title '<title>' --ep NN  (project + palette + music), then push to the Mac skeleton (new-video 4, pack.py) ; state.py videoNN stage folders-ready.
7. Reply with report 'ready'. Then python3 engine/tools/studio.py close videoNN folders-ready.
build: 0. On the Mac: guard.py claim (REFUSED = stop). Pull (video-preview 0). studio.py status shows the stage. Files present? images/ and vo/raw/vo_full.mp3 - if not, report 'missing' and stop.
1. vo_split.py then vo_prep.py (AMBIGUOUS: use the best-estimate cuts, say so in one line; never re-ask for a new take). state.py videoNN stage vo-received.
2. python3 engine/tools/studio.py look videoNN  - prints the palette, ready-made scene themes and motif. Build ONLY from these colours.

5. audit.py --fast while iterating; full audit.py must PASS. Then audio.py, then: python3 engine/tools/studio.py check videoNN --stage build  must print STUDIO PASS (palette, music, sound effects, moods, ending).
6. render.py --preview -> drafts/. Style frames and preview are approved together: send the preview only.
6. audio.py -> render.py --preview -> drafts/. Style frames and preview are approved together: send the preview only.
7. Push (video-preview 5). state.py videoNN stage built. Send report 'preview'. Close: studio.py close videoNN built.
8. On 'go ahead': state.py videoNN approve preview; studio.py close videoNN preview-approved; release the claim.
finish: FINISH videoNN  (own chat or the same chat after approval; claim first)

1. Two cover concepts designed by hand (cover-design.md: different ideas, episode palette, real photo/cutout hero, title = question without the answer). cover.py renders, cover_check.py must print COVER PASS, then look at the sheet. Send report 'cover'. Creator picks.
2. make_srt.py, English captions, publish.txt - no placeholder left (video-render 2).
3. python3 engine/tools/finish.py ... (video-render top). It renders, bakes the cover, packs, tidies. Verify on the Mac: finish.py --verify must print DONE.
4. python3 engine/tools/studio.py check videoNN --stage final  must print STUDIO PASS.
5. python3 _series/tools/studio.py close videoNN delivered --note '<single-source caveat>'  (writes state + STATUS.md).

stage_waiting_on.script-approved: Claude: VO text + image list + folders
stage_waiting_on.folders-ready: YOU: images + VO take, then 'Build episode NN'
stage_waiting_on.built: YOU: watch preview, 'go ahead' or notes
